ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels localized on the lateral lobe surfaces against 60% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the outer two-thirds of the right lobe and the upper outer half of the left lobe; central region is a solid black mass with small circular high-intensity white incursions; right lobe white field is punctuated by numerous dark, roughly circular pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 25-30 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude serration pattern; numerous jagged peaks and deep valleys are continuous across both lobe edges; most prominent spikes located on the medial-to-distal sections of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature leading to distinctly upward-tilted, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense population of concentric circular rings; dark-centered rings on the white right lobe and white-centered rings on the black central region; physical barnacle clusters (calcium-white, high-relief bumps) present on both lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel horizontal linear white pixel disruptions in the upper-mid dark section; one vertical linear mark on the lower inner left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive colonization of barnacles on the lateral margins of both lobes; a significant irregular notch or 'chip' missing from the trailing edge of the left lobe near the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast 'eye-like' or 'donut' circular scarring patterns distributed across both lobes, creating a distinctive mottled texture.
